questions.text: A shopkeeper sells a cricket bat with a marked price of ₹5,000. He offers two alternatives: Scheme A: 15% discount followed by a further 10% discount on the reduced price. Scheme B: A single flat discount of x%. To make the final selling price identical in both schemes, what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
Discount A = 15%. Remaining = 85%.
Discount B = 10%. Remaining = 90%.
Combined Remaining = 85% x 90% = 0.85 x 0.90 = 0.765.
Total Discount = 1 - 0.765 = 0.235.
x = 23.5%.

questions.text: A bank offers a special 'Festival Savings Scheme' where the interest rate for the first year is 5% per annum on the principal. However, the interest earned in the first year is added to the principal at the end of the year. If a customer deposits ₹10,000 and closes the account after exactly one year, what is the total amount received?
questions.solution:
Simple Interest = (P * R * T) / 100.
Substituting values: P = 10000, R = 5%, T = 1 year.
SI = (10000 * 5 * 1) / 100.
SI = 500.
Total Amount = Principal + Interest = 10000 + 500 = 10500.

A retailer marks up a commodity by 25% above its cost price. He then offers a discount of x% on this marked price. If the final selling price equals the original cost price plus half of the initial profit he would have made had there been no discount, what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
Let Cost Price (CP) = Rs. 100.
Initial Profit (if no discount) = Marked Price - CP = 125 - 100 = 25.
Half of this initial profit = 25 / 2 = 12.5.
Target Selling Price = CP + Half Initial Profit = 100 + 12.5 = 112.5.
Marked Price (MP) = 125.
Discount Amount = MP - SP = 125 - 112.5 = 12.5.
Discount Percentage (x) = (Discount / MP) * 100 = (12.5 / 125) * 100 = 10%.

questions.text: What is the key legal distinction between an Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) and the territorial sea?

options.label: A
options.text: EEZ grants full legislative jurisdiction up to 200 nm

options.label: B
options.text: EEZ grants sovereign rights over resources only, not full legislative jurisdiction

options.label: C
options.text: Territorial sea extends to 200 nm while EEZ extends to 12 nm

options.label: D
options.text: EEZ includes rights over seabed minerals but territorial sea does not

questions.solution: Correct answer: EEZ grants sovereign rights over resources only, not full legislative jurisdiction.

questions.text: Which of the following sentences misuses a discourse marker?

options.label: C
options.text: The data were incomplete; moreover, the conclusions remain tentative.

options.label: D

questions.solution: Correct answer: The model predicts a rise; on the contrary, the observed trend is downward..

questions.text: In the sentence 'Walking down the street, the trees looked beautiful,' what is the error?

options.label: B
options.text: Misplaced modifier: 'Walking' should modify the subject 'trees', but trees cannot walk.

options.label: C
options.text: Parallelism error in the verb phrase

questions.solution: Correct answer: Misplaced modifier: 'Walking' should modify the subject 'trees', but trees cannot walk..
